title: Il Periodo Ipotetico di Terzo Tipo
subtitle: "If I had known..." — the impossible past.
objectives: Form the third type hypothetical sentence for the unreal past
Use the condizionale passato in the main clause
Recognize mixed hypotheticals (past condition, present consequence)

content.intro: The third type of hypothetical sentence talks about something that didn't happen in the past — and, by logical necessity, whose consequence also never happened.
content.explanation: Se + congiuntivo trapassato, condizionale passato (avrei/sarei + past participle): Se avessi saputo, sarei venuto. (If I had known, I would have come — but I didn't know, and I didn't come.) Both halves describe a counterfactual past.

rules.heading: a) Formation
rules.body: se + avessi/fossi + participle, avrei/sarei + participle: Se avessi studiato di più, avrei passato l'esame.

rules.heading: b) Mixed hypothetical
rules.body: A past condition can have a present consequence: Se avessi accettato quel lavoro, ora vivrei a Milano. (If I had accepted that job, I'd be living in Milan now.) — condizionale presente in the main clause, since the consequence is felt now, not back then.

examples.it: Se avessi saputo, ti avrei chiamato subito.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have called you right away.

examples.it: Se non avessimo perso il treno, saremmo già arrivati.
examples.en: If we hadn't missed the train, we would already have arrived.

examples.it: Avrei accettato l'offerta se me l'avessero fatta prima.
examples.en: I would have accepted the offer if they had made it to me sooner.

examples.it: Se mi fossi laureato in ingegneria, ora lavorerei in un'altra azienda.
examples.en: If I had graduated in engineering, I'd be working at a different company now. (mixed)

commonMistakes.why: The se-clause needs the congiuntivo trapassato, never the conditional — same rule as the second type, one tense further back.

commonMistakes.wrong: Se avessi studiato di più, avessi passato l'esame.
commonMistakes.right: Se avessi studiato di più, avrei passato l'esame.
commonMistakes.why: The main clause needs the condizionale passato, not a repeated subjunctive.

items.prompt: Which mood/tense goes in the se-clause of the third type?
items.explanation: The se-clause always needs the congiuntivo trapassato in the third type.

items.prompt: Which mood/tense goes in the main clause of the third type?
items.explanation: The main clause needs the condizionale passato.

I will know and I will come.
items.explanation: The third type describes a counterfactual past.

items.prompt: A mixed hypothetical pairs a past condition with which kind of consequence?
items.explanation: The consequence is felt now, so it uses the condizionale presente.

items.prompt: Which sentence is a correct mixed hypothetical?
options: Se avessi accettato quel lavoro, ora vivrei a Milano.
Se accetterei quel lavoro, vivrei a Milano.
Se ho accettato quel lavoro, vivo a Milano.
items.explanation: Past condition (congiuntivo trapassato) + present consequence (condizionale presente).

items.prompt: The third type describes a condition that is...
options: possible but unlikely, in the present
items.explanation: The third type is specifically about the unreal past.

items.prompt: Which is the correct condizionale passato of "venire", noi form?
items.explanation: Venire takes essere, so the condizionale passato is saremmo venuti.

items.prompt: "Avrei accettato l'offerta se me l'avessero fatta prima" — the order of clauses...
options: can be flipped without changing meaning
items.explanation: The main clause and se-clause can appear in either order.

items.statement: The third type talks about a condition and consequence that both did not happen.
items.explanation: Both halves describe a counterfactual past.

items.statement: The se-clause of the third type can use the conditional instead of the congiuntivo trapassato.
items.explanation: The se-clause always needs the congiuntivo trapassato, never the conditional.

items.statement: A mixed hypothetical uses condizionale presente in the main clause for a present-day consequence.
items.explanation: This is exactly the mixed hypothetical pattern.

items.statement: The third type is used for real, likely conditions.
items.explanation: That's the first type; the third type is for the unreal past.

items.statement: Condizionale passato is built from avrei/sarei + past participle.
items.explanation: This is exactly how the condizionale passato is formed.

items.statement: The se-clause and main clause can appear in either order without changing the meaning.
items.explanation: Word order between the two clauses is flexible.

items.statement: The third type never mixes with a present consequence.
items.explanation: Mixed hypotheticals do exactly that, pairing a past condition with a present consequence.

items.statement: "Se avrei saputo" is a correct way to start a third-type sentence.
items.explanation: The se-clause needs the congiuntivo trapassato, never the conditional.

summary: Third type (unreal past): se + congiuntivo trapassato, condizionale passato.
Both halves are counterfactual: neither the condition nor its consequence actually happened.
A mixed hypothetical pairs a past condition with a condizionale presente for a present consequence.
